researchClaims.claim: Same terminal institutional score and same mean radial travel can coexist with different collective task feasibility when access windows differ.
Original 6x5 capability matrix is rank 5; row-masked Alpha rank 4. Neither rank measures task feasibility.

On a common time axis at one host, three single closed availability intervals with every pair overlapping for at least dwell d must have a triple overlap of at least d (one-dimensional Helly). Split nonconvex availability sets allow all three pairwise overlaps >=d while their triple intersection is empty.
Discrete Stokes determines boundary circulation from an explicitly specified 1-cochain; historical witness recovery requires additional measurements and justified coupling.
Invertible holonomy may erase backtracking while an additive material-cost accumulator retains it.
Z_C=sqrt(3)/2 is an exact unit equilateral apex; a claimed Marrowline phase attractor and zero mirror rate require separate actual observations.

Within a fixed symmetric four-node graph, fixed queue, fixed windows and deterministic FIFO routing, decreasing radial times cannot shrink feasible three-carrier overlap; the accident requires another changed constraint.
Headcounts initial=60 and retained=18 cannot identify 42 hidden displaced persons without observing independent exits: 42 displaced/0 exited and 0 displaced/42 exited have identical headline counts.
Independent Atlas branch evaluates 1,512 synthetic policies; 625 have radial compression above one and infeasible triadic collaboration, conditional on specified graph and clocks.
